conf.description: F5 BIG-IP APM ACL enforcement log (0158xxxx family), syslog-raw: positional tail parse with the URL element optional for L4-only matches

conf.comment: F5 BIG-IP APM ACL enforcement log (0158xxxx message family, /var/log/pktfilter via tmm), syslog-raw. Positional tail per recommendations.direct.cribl: <action> ACL: <acl>@<session>:<index> packet: [<url>] <proto> <src>:<port> -> <dst>:<port>, URL optional so L4-only matches aren't dropped. Volume sampling/aggregation of allow records and the action-to-event.type direction are assigned to Elastic/the route by recommendations.elastic and recommendations.cribl's volume guidance respectively - not duplicated in this pipeline. No concrete URL length cap was given in the catalog, so none is applied here; recorded as a gap.

functions.description: why this pipeline is shaped this way

parse the stable BSD header + profile:partition:sessionid triple, same shape as the other two APM datasets; confirm the 0158xxxx ids in use on the local platform version rather than trusting only the two examples given
L7 shape: action, acl@session:index token, URL, protocol, source and destination address:port
L4-only shape (no URL element); only runs when the L7 pattern above did not already set protocol
split the L7 URL into domain and path

batch rename every status:mapped/unmapped field that needs no casting or conditional logic; rule.id is deliberately left unset, per the catalog, since the entry index names a line inside the ACL rather than the ACL itself

TMM instance normalised to a family name; discard/reject/continue kept distinct (no collapsing to a single deny) per the transform note; ports and entry index cast to number; URL split fields promoted
BSD header carries no year or timezone; best-effort current-year/UTC parse into _time per platform constraint 1 - same unresolved per-device-tz gap as the other two APM datasets
tag the dataset, hyphen-free per platform constraint 5
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
